article.en: A public house which was recently bought by Mr Ian Thompson is up for sale.
article.zh: 伊恩·汤普森先生最近才买的小酒店现在又要卖出去。

article.en: Mr Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
article.zh: 汤普森先生之所以想卖它，是因为那里常闹鬼。

article.en: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night.
article.zh: 他告诉我有天夜里他怎么也睡不着。

article.en: He heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
article.zh: 他听到酒吧里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

article.en: The next morning, he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
article.zh: 第二天早上，他发现酒吧间的门被椅子堵上了，家具也被挪动过。

article.en: Though Mr Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed, they were on in the morning.
article.zh: 虽然汤普森先生临睡觉时把灯关了，但早晨灯却亮着。

article.en: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
article.zh: 他还说发现了五只空的威士忌酒瓶子，这肯定是鬼魂头天晚上喝的。

article.en: I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink.
article.zh: 我暗示说，一定是村里有些人来喝不花钱的酒。

article.en: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
article.zh: 村里人已经告诉他，即使他把小酒店白送人，他们也不要。
